SearchTerm.title: SearchTerm
SearchTerm.description: Partial account name to search for using a LIKE match, for example 'AstraZeneca'. At least one of SearchTerm, IndustryFilter, or TypeFilter must be provided.

IndustryFilter.title: IndustryFilter
IndustryFilter.description: Exact industry value to filter by, for example 'Biotechnology' or 'Pharmaceuticals'. At least one of SearchTerm, IndustryFilter, or TypeFilter must be provided.

TypeFilter.title: TypeFilter
TypeFilter.description: Exact account type value to filter by, for example 'Customer' or 'Partner'. At least one of SearchTerm, IndustryFilter, or TypeFilter must be provided.
